notes: sprs_weight is the number of points DEDUCTED from 110 when a control is not met, per the DoD Assessment Methodology (values are 1, 3, or 5).
This catalog is a SEED subset covering the controls Aeglero addresses today. It is expanded toward the full 110 controls over time; see GOALS.md / the generated POA&M.
Objectives use the [a],[b],[c] determination-statement style from NIST SP 800-171A.
assessment_method values follow 800-171A: EXAMINE, TEST, INTERVIEW.

controls.title: Create and retain system audit logs and records to the extent needed to enable the monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized system activity.

objectives.text: audit logs needed to enable monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting are specified.

controls.title: Ensure that the actions of individual system users can be uniquely traced to those users, so they can be held accountable for their actions.

objectives.text: the content of audit records needed to support the ability to uniquely trace users to their actions is defined.
audit records, once created, contain the defined content.

controls.title: Protect audit information and audit logging tools from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion.

objectives.text: audit information is protected from unauthorized modification.
audit information is protected from unauthorized deletion.

controls.title: Limit system access to authorized users, processes acting on behalf of authorized users, and devices (including other systems).

objectives.text: system access is limited to authorized users.

controls.title: Limit system access to the types of transactions and functions that authorized users are permitted to execute.

objectives.text: system access is limited to the defined types of transactions and functions for authorized users.

controls.title: Use multifactor authentication for local and network access to privileged accounts and for network access to non-privileged accounts.

objectives.text: multifactor authentication is implemented for network access to privileged accounts.
multifactor authentication is implemented for network access to non-privileged accounts.

controls.title: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure of CUI during transmission unless otherwise protected by alternative physical safeguards.

objectives.text: cryptographic mechanisms intended to prevent unauthorized disclosure of information during transmission are implemented.

controls.title: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography when used to protect the confidentiality of CUI.

objectives.text: FIPS-validated cryptography is employed to protect the confidentiality of CUI.

controls.title: Identify, report, and correct system flaws in a timely manner.

objectives.text: system flaws are corrected in a timely manner.

controls.title: Scan for vulnerabilities in organizational systems and applications periodically and when new vulnerabilities affecting those systems and applications are identified.

objectives.text: the frequency to scan for vulnerabilities is defined.
vulnerabilities are scanned for when new vulnerabilities are identified.
